title: DiracX Routers
description: HTTP and database activity of the DiracX API servers (OpenTelemetry metrics)

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: HTTP requests per second, all routes.

panels.title: Server errors (5xx)
panels.description: Share of the requests answered with a 5xx status.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the request duration, all routes.

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Requests currently being served by all the instances.

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Number of API server instances reporting metrics.

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Requests per second, by class of HTTP status code.

panels.title: Busiest routes
panels.description: Requests per second for the 8 busiest routes.

panels.title: Server errors (5xx) by route
panels.description: Requests answered with a 5xx status, per route. Look for the corresponding traces (status=error) to find the cause.

targets.expr: sum by (http_request_method, http_route, http_response_status_code) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Client errors (4xx) by route
panels.description: Requests answered with a 4xx status (8 largest). A burst of 401/403 usually indicates a token or policy problem.

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (http_request_method, http_route, http_response_status_code) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Request duration percentiles
panels.description: Request duration percentiles over all the selected routes.

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of the request duration for the 8 slowest routes.

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Routes over the selected time range
panels.description: Every route with its number of requests, latency and error ratio over the dashboard time range. Sort by any column.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

(sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Request rate by instance
panels.description: Requests per second per instance: the load should be spread evenly.

panels.title: Requests in flight by instance
panels.description: Requests being served. A steadily growing value means requests are stuck (e.g. waiting for the database).

panels.title: Requests by client version
panels.description: Requests per version of the DiracX client (DiracX-Client-Version header). none: no header (web interface, direct HTTP requests); invalid: unparsable version; other: more versions than tracked.

panels.title: Rejected clients
panels.description: Requests refused because the client is older than the minimum supported version (or sent an invalid version).

panels.title: Client versions over the selected time range
panels.description: Every client version seen over the dashboard time range, to decide whether the minimum client version can be raised.

targets.expr: sum by (client_version) (increase(client_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", outcome="rejected"}[$__range])) or sum by (client_version) (increase(client_requests_total{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance"}[$__range])) * 0

panels.title: Query latency p95 by database
panels.description: 95th percentile of the SQL query duration, per database.

panels.title: Queries by database and operation
panels.description: SQL queries per second (8 busiest database/operation pairs).

panels.title: Query errors
panels.description: SQL queries which raised an exception, per database and exception type.

targets.expr: sum by (db_namespace, error_type) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", diracx_component="routers", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Connection pool usage (busiest instance)
panels.description: Connections checked out of the SQLAlchemy pool over the pool capacity (pool_size + max_overflow), for the instance with the fullest pool. At 100%, requests wait for a connection.

targets.expr: max by (db_client_connection_pool_name) (db_client_connection_count{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", diracx_component="routers", db_client_connection_state="used"} / ignoring (db_client_connection_state) db_client_connection_max{service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$instance", diracx_component="routers"})

panels.title: Connection wait p95 by database
panels.description: Time spent waiting for a connection of the pool (95th percentile). It should stay far below the query latency: if not, the pool is too small for the load.

panels.title: Connection timeouts
panels.description: Requests or tasks which failed because no connection of the pool was available before pool_timeout.

panels.title: Connections in use by instance
panels.description: Connections currently checked out of the pools, per instance.
